Details of 16 patients who were considered to have taken an overdosage of piroxicam alone were reported1 to the National Poisons Information Service of the UK. Thirteen patients (including 5 children) had no symptoms after doses esti- mated to be up to 300 to 400 mg; 2 patients complained of dizzi- ness and blurred vision after 200 to 300 mg; the last patient, who claimed to have taken 600 mg presented in coma, regained con- sciousness within one hour, and had recovered fully within 24 hours. Severe multisystem toxicity has been reported in a 2-year- old child after ingestion of 100 mg of piroxicam.2 1. Court H, Volans GN.
